wins.text: Net income of $5.5B or $1.60 per diluted share, up from both Q1 and a year ago; ROTCE reached 15% (including Merchant Services gain)
Asset cap lifted — a pivotal milestone ending a multi-year regulatory constraint; 13 consent orders terminated since 2019, including 7 in 2025 alone
Net loan charge-off ratio declined 13 bps YoY and 1 bp QoQ; consumer net charge-offs down $48M from Q1; nonperforming assets declined 3% from Q1
$40B additional common stock repurchase program authorized by Board; $6B+ repurchased in H1 2025; dividend raised 12.5% to $0.45/share in Q3
Investment banking fees up 9% YoY; IB market share gains in leveraged finance and M&A for second consecutive year; WIM net asset flows of $16B+ in H1, up 60% YoY

risks.text: Full-year NII guidance revised to roughly in line with 2024's $47.7B, down from prior guidance of low-single-digit growth, driven by increased balance sheet allocation to low/non-earning markets assets
Commercial loan growth remained modest as clients stayed cautious awaiting trade/tariff clarity; middle market spreads remain compressed due to intense bank competition
Tariff and macro uncertainty flagged explicitly — commercial clients not growing inventories or hiring aggressively, preparing contingency plans for downside scenarios
CRE office portfolio remains a concern — management expects additional losses, though valuations appear to be stabilizing; allowance coverage at 11.1%

Capital framework uncertainty — SCB declined 120 bps but Fed CCAR process and broader capital rules still in flux, preventing management from committing to a definitive capital target or updated ROTCE target

guidance_items.detail: Full-year NII now expected roughly in line with 2024's $47.7B, down from prior guidance of slightly above that level; largest driver is increased markets balance sheet allocation generating fees rather than NII
NII expected to grow sequentially in both Q3 and Q4 2025
2025 noninterest expense outlook unchanged at approximately $54.2B
Q3 common stock dividend raised 12.5% to $0.45/share, subject to Board approval; $40B buyback authorization added

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Timing and specifics of updated medium-term ROTCE target above 15% — management did not proactively address when or at what level a new target would be set
Competitive loan spread compression from other banks and nonbank lenders in middle market — not mentioned in prepared remarks
Tax rate volatility and impact of new legislation reducing clean energy tax credits on WFC's tax credit investment business
